parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the list of E-HPC clusters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

You can call the [ListRegions](~~188593~~) operation to query the list of regions where E-HPC is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc sync-users --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-gh5WKb0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
